summary: DRA_EQUAL_CAPITAL_TWO_SLOT_CAPACITY_BRANCH_CLOSE. The exact 52,608-row pre-2025 sealed corpus and both frozen one-slot parent checkpoints passed. Under the same 60 USDT initial equity, the two-slot candidate raised Design total PnL from 29.51253580 to 38.47075995 USDT and historical Validation total PnL from 39.93354639 to 63.67486483 USDT while lowering blocked entries. The apparent uplift failed the frozen risk-adjusted mechanism rule: Design drawdown rose from 25.405140% to 42.180561%, Validation drawdown rose from 9.794701% to 17.393381%, completed holding distributions worsened in both windows, and annual drawdown breadth was 0/5. This post-hoc capacity-scaling family is closed with no rescue variant, no alpha or strategy-candidate claim, and no OOS access.
